title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute
title_zh: 苹果推出M6和M5 Ultra，实现性能和AI计算的飞跃

paragraphs.en: M6 delivers a revolutionary leap in everyday performance and power efficiency. M5 Ultra unleashes unprecedented desktop-class power and massive unified memory bandwidth to conquer the most demanding projects. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today debuted M6 in the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio, providing an extraordinary leap in performance and AI capabilities. M6, Apple’s first state-of-the-art 2-nanometer chip, advances every compute block, delivering gains across every dimension of performance. The chip features a larger 12-core CPU complex with the world’s fastest CPU core, a larger 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth. 1 M5 Ultra, the ultimate powerhouse for pro and AI workloads, uses next-generation UltraFusion technology to form a quad-die architecture for the first time in an M-series system on a chip (SoC). The chip includes an up-to-36-core CPU and up-to-80-core GPU with a massive 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth, 50 percent more than M3 Ultra. With their advanced technologies, these SoCs deliver extraordinary compute with industry-leading power efficiency, empowering users to do even more on a desktop. “Today, we’re debuting the next giant leap in performance and AI compute for Apple silicon with the incredibly advanced M6 and the most powerful M-series chip yet, M5 Ultra,” said Sri Santhanam, Apple’s vice president of Silicon Engineering Group. “Built using the cutting-edge 2 nm process, M6 combines a new CPU complex, two additional CPU and GPU cores, a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and more unified memory bandwidth to power through workloads with amazing energy efficiency. And for the ultimate desktop performance and the ability to run massive AI models, M5 Ultra features a massive GPU, now with Neural Accelerators, and more unified memory bandwidth, pushing the boundaries of what a desktop can do.” M6: Optimized Design and Enhanced Performance Designed to power the workflows of everyday users, students, developers, AI hobbyists, and enterprises, M6 offers the ideal balance of performance, power efficiency, and on-device AI to effortlessly fly through daily tasks, coding, and creative projects. M6 is built using cutting-edge 2 nm process technology, packing greater transistor density into a smaller die for a major leap in performance and power efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: M6 在日常性能和能效方面实现了革命性的飞跃。 M5 Ultra 释放出前所未有的桌面级性能与巨大的统一内存带宽，足以应对最复杂的项目挑战。 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日发布了搭载 M6 芯片的新款 Mac mini 和搭载 M5 Ultra 芯片的新款 Mac Studio，在性能和 AI 能力上实现了非凡的突破。 M6 是苹果首款顶尖的 2 纳米制程芯片，它升级了每一个计算模块，在性能的所有维度上都带来了显著提升。 该芯片拥有更大的 12 核 CPU 集群，搭载全球最快的 CPU 核心；更大的 12 核 GPU，配备神经加速引擎；双 16 核神经网络引擎，以及高达 170GB/s 的统一内存带宽。1 M5 Ultra 是专业工作和 AI 负载的终极性能猛兽，它采用新一代 UltraFusion 技术，首次在 M 系列系统级芯片（SoC）中构建出四芯架构。 该芯片包含最多 36 核 CPU 和最多 80 核 GPU，并拥有高达 1.2TB/s 的统一内存带宽，比 M3 Ultra 提升了 50%。 凭借先进的技术，这些系统级芯片（SoC）实现了卓越的计算性能与行业领先的能效，让用户在桌面端能完成更多任务。“今天，我们通过极其先进的 M6 和迄今最强大的 M 系列芯片 M5 Ultra，为 Apple 硅芯片带来了性能和 AI 计算的又一次巨大飞跃。”苹果硅工程集团副总裁 Sri Santhanam 表示。“M6 采用尖端的 2 纳米工艺打造，集成了全新的 CPU 集群、两个额外的 CPU 和 GPU 核心、双 16 核神经网络引擎以及更宽的统一内存带宽，能够以惊人的能效处理各种工作负载。 “而 M5 Ultra 则专为极致的桌面性能和运行大型 AI 模型而设计，它配备了拥有神经加速引擎的超大 GPU 和更宽的统一内存带宽，不断拓展桌面计算机的极限。”M6：优化设计与增强性能 M6 专为日常用户、学生、开发者、AI 爱好者和企业的工作流程而设计，在性能、能效和设备端 AI 能力之间实现了理想平衡，让日常任务、编程和创意项目都能轻松完成。 M6 采用尖端的 2 纳米制程技术打造，在更小的芯片面积内集成了更高密度的晶体管，从而在性能和能效上实现了重大突破。

paragraphs.en: M6 also introduces a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, providing up to 2x the peak compute over previous generations to make on-device AI workflows run even faster. System frameworks can automatically utilize both engines simultaneously, enabling applications to see faster model execution. Powered by the all-new 2 nm M6, Mac mini provides an incredibly fast and responsive experience for creative workflows in apps like Adobe Photoshop. M6 has a brand-new 12-core CPU complex — two more cores than M5 — that consists of 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores. It delivers the world’s fastest single-threaded performance and up to 1.2x faster multithreaded performance as compared to M5, and up to 2.4x faster than M1. 2 The super cores blaze through single-threaded workloads, the performance cores use less power and join the super cores to run demanding multithreaded workloads, and the efficiency cores handle everyday background tasks — all with industry-leading performance per watt. As a result, demanding CPU tasks such as editing images, compiling code, indexing new files, and running agentic AI workloads are faster than ever. Accelerated GPU and Faster Memory Bandwidth M6 features a 12-core GPU — two more cores than M5 — with a Neural Accelerator in each core. This design delivers a nearly 30 percent increase in peak GPU compute for AI compared to M5, and more than 8x compared to M1, enabling significantly faster prompt processing when interacting with on-device LLMs. 2 M6 features a powerful, larger 12-core GPU that provides higher geometry rates and updated Dynamic Caching to deliver stunning visuals and fluid frame rates in demanding games like Mixtape. In addition, M6 offers Apple’s latest advanced graphics capabilities, including updates to the shader core architecture, Dynamic Caching, and hardware-accelerated ray tracing. These technologies combine to deliver stunning visual realism, faster rendering, and higher frame rates for gaming. M6 also has 50 percent increased geometry rates for complex graphics. M6 supports up to 32GB of unified memory to multitask across demanding apps and run LLMs on device for secure and private agentic tasks. It also provides up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth — a 10 percent increase over M5 and a 2.5x increase over M1.
paragraphs.zh: M6 还引入了双 16 核神经网络引擎，其峰值计算能力是上一代产品的两倍，使设备端的人工智能工作流程运行得更快。 系统框架可以同时自动利用这两个引擎，让应用程序实现更快的模型执行速度。 全新 2 纳米 M6 芯片为 Mac mini 提供了强大动力，在 Adobe Photoshop 等应用中，创意工作流程的体验极其快速且响应灵敏。 M6 拥有全新的 12 核 CPU 核心组——比 M5 多两个核心——包括 2 个超级核心、4 个性能核心和 6 个能效核心。 与 M5 相比，它实现了全球最快的单线程性能以及高达 1.2 倍的更快多线程性能；与 M1 相比，其性能提升高达 2.4 倍。2 超级核心可高速处理单线程任务，性能核心功耗更低，可与超级核心共同运行高要求的多线程任务，而能效核心则负责日常后台任务——这一切都实现了业界领先的每瓦特性能。 因此，图像编辑、代码编译、新文件索引以及运行智能体式人工智能工作负载等耗资源较大的 CPU 任务，其速度比以往任何时候都快。 加速的 GPU 与更快的内存带宽 M6 配备 12 核 GPU——比 M5 多两个核心——每个核心都集成了神经网络加速器。 这一设计使 M6 的人工智能峰值 GPU 计算能力相比 M5 提升了近 30%，相比 M1 则提升超过 8 倍，在与设备端大语言模型交互时，提示词处理速度显著加快。2 M6 拥有更强大、规模更大的 12 核 GPU，可提供更高的几何处理速率和更新后的动态缓存技术，在《Mixtape》等高要求游戏中呈现惊艳的视觉效果和流畅的帧率。 此外，M6 还带来了苹果最新的先进图形功能，包括着色器核心架构的更新、动态缓存以及硬件加速的光线追踪。 这些技术相结合，为游戏带来了令人惊叹的视觉真实感、更快的渲染速度和更高的帧率。 M6 在复杂图形处理方面的几何速率也提升了 50%。 M6 支持高达 32GB 的统一内存，可在高要求的应用程序间轻松多任务处理，并在设备端运行大语言模型，以安全、私密的方式执行智能体式任务。 它还提供了高达 170GB/s 的统一内存带宽——比 M5 提升 10%，比 M1 提升 2.5 倍。

paragraphs.en: With a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, larger GPU with Neural Accelerators, and higher unified memory bandwidth, M6 enables developers to compile code, index files, and run multiple simulators in Xcode with incredible speed. M5 Ultra: The Ultimate Powerhouse for Pro Workflows M5 Ultra, Apple’s most powerful chip ever, is built for pros who need to speed through workloads that demand maximum CPU and GPU performance and unified memory bandwidth, such as complex 3D rendering, visual effects, scientific analysis, and running compute-intensive frontier AI models on device. Mac Studio with M5 Ultra delivers extreme performance and memory bandwidth to edit complex timelines with multiple streams of high-resolution video and effects in Adobe Premiere Pro. M5 Ultra uses UltraFusion to connect two dual-die M5 Max chips to form the quad-die architecture — a first for Apple silicon. UltraFusion increases the inter-die bandwidth to over 4.4TB/s and the connection density by over 6x. Together, these ultra-low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnects allow the four dies to behave as a single unified processor. M5 Ultra also features a large up-to-36-core CPU consisting of 12 super cores and 24 performance cores, delivering up to 1.25x higher single-threaded performance and up to 1.3x higher multithreaded performance than M3 Ultra. 3 Unprecedented AI and Graphics, Massive Memory Capacity M5 Ultra features a next-generation GPU with up to 80 cores, incorporating a Neural Accelerator in each core to offer up to 4.5x the peak GPU compute for AI compared to M3 Ultra and over 6x more than M1 Ultra. 3 The GPU includes Apple’s latest shader core with second-generation Dynamic Caching, as well as hardware-accelerated mesh shading and third-generation ray tracing, delivering up to 40 percent faster graphics performance than M3 Ultra. 3 Utilizing the powerful up-to-80-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, Mac Studio with M5 Ultra enables creators to generate high-quality AI images locally on device using apps like Draw Things. M5 Ultra incorporates a more capable Media Engine. Dedicated hardware-enabled H.264, HEVC, four ProRes encode and decode engines, and hardware-accelerated AV1 decode make it the ultimate solution for high-resolution video editing. M5 Ultra also includes a 32-core Neural Engine, driving complex AI tasks and Apple Intelligence features securely on device with industry-leading energy efficiency.

paragraphs.en: 4 With up to 512GB of unified memory and 1.2TB/s of memory bandwidth, Mac Studio with M5 Ultra enables researchers to leverage local AI models in LM Studio Bionic to trigger complex simulations in MATLAB. paragraphs.en: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute
paragraphs.zh: 苹果推出 M6 和 M5 Ultra，实现性能与 AI 计算能力的巨大飞跃

paragraphs.en: M6, Apple’s first 2 nm chip, features a larger, more powerful 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, and Dual 16-core Neural Engine, while M5 Ultra is Apple’s first quad-die architecture and its most powerful chip ever
paragraphs.zh: M6 是苹果首款 2 纳米芯片，配备了更大、更强大的 12 核 CPU、12 核 GPU 和双 16 核神经网络引擎；而 M5 Ultra 则是苹果首款采用四芯片堆叠架构的芯片，也是其迄今为止性能最强的芯片。

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today debuted M6 in the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio, providing an extraordinary leap in performance and AI capabilities. M6, Apple’s first state-of-the-art 2-nanometer chip, advances every compute block, delivering gains across every dimension of performance. The chip features a larger 12-core CPU complex with the world’s fastest CPU core, a larger 12-core GPU with Neural Accelerators, a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, and up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth. 1 M5 Ultra, the ultimate powerhouse for pro and AI workloads, uses next-generation UltraFusion technology to form a quad-die architecture for the first time in an M-series system on a chip (SoC). The chip includes an up-to-36-core CPU and up-to-80-core GPU with a massive 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth, 50 percent more than M3 Ultra. With their advanced technologies, these SoCs deliver extraordinary compute with industry-leading power efficiency, empowering users to do even more on a desktop.
paragraphs.zh: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日在新款 Mac mini 中推出了 M6，在新款 Mac Studio 中推出了 M5 Ultra，实现了性能和人工智能能力的非凡飞跃。 M6 是苹果首款最先进的 2 纳米芯片，它升级了每一个计算模块，在性能的所有维度上带来了显著提升。 该芯片拥有更大的 12 核 CPU 核心群，搭载全球最快的 CPU 核心；更大的 12 核 GPU，配备神经加速器；双 16 核神经网络引擎，以及高达 170GB/s 的统一内存带宽。1 M5 Ultra 是专业工作和人工智能工作负载的终极性能猛兽，它采用新一代 UltraFusion 技术，首次在 M 系列系统级芯片（SoC）中构建出四芯片架构。 该芯片包含最多 36 核的 CPU 和最多 80 核的 GPU，并拥有高达 1.2TB/s 的统一内存带宽，比 M3 Ultra 提升了 50%。 凭借这些先进技术，这些系统级芯片实现了卓越的计算性能与行业领先的能效，让用户在台式电脑上能够完成更多任务。

paragraphs.en: M6: Optimized Design and Enhanced Performance

paragraphs.zh: M6 采用尖端的 2 纳米工艺制造，在更小的芯片上实现了更高的晶体管密度，从而在性能和能效方面实现了重大飞跃。 M6 还引入了双 16 核神经网络引擎，其峰值计算能力是上一代产品的两倍，使设备端的人工智能工作流程运行得更快。 系统框架可以同时自动利用这两个引擎，让应用程序实现更快的模型执行速度。

sents.en: M6 is built using cutting-edge 2 nm process technology, packing greater transistor density into a smaller die for a major leap in performance and power efficiency.
sents.zh: M6 采用尖端的 2 纳米工艺制造，在更小的芯片上实现了更高的晶体管密度，从而在性能和能效方面实现了重大飞跃。

sents.en: M6 also introduces a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, providing up to 2x the peak compute over previous generations to make on-device AI workflows run even faster.
sents.zh: M6 还引入了双 16 核神经网络引擎，其峰值计算能力是上一代产品的两倍，使设备端的人工智能工作流程运行得更快。

sents.en: System frameworks can automatically utilize both engines simultaneously, enabling applications to see faster model execution.
sents.zh: 系统框架可以同时自动利用这两个引擎，让应用程序实现更快的模型执行速度。

paragraphs.en: M6 has a brand-new 12-core CPU complex — two more cores than M5 — that consists of 2 super cores, 4 performance cores, and 6 efficiency cores. It delivers the world’s fastest single-threaded performance and up to 1.2x faster multithreaded performance as compared to M5, and up to 2.4x faster than M1. 2 The super cores blaze through single-threaded workloads, the performance cores use less power and join the super cores to run demanding multithreaded workloads, and the efficiency cores handle everyday background tasks — all with industry-leading performance per watt. As a result, demanding CPU tasks such as editing images, compiling code, indexing new files, and running agentic AI workloads are faster than ever.
paragraphs.zh: M6 搭载全新的 12 核 CPU 核心群——比 M5 多两个核心——由 2 个超级核心、4 个性能核心和 6 个能效核心组成。 与 M5 相比，它可提供全球最快的单线程性能以及高达 1.2 倍的多线程性能，并且比 M1 快高达 2.4 倍。2 超级核心可快速处理单线程任务，性能核心功耗更低，并与超级核心共同运行高要求的多线程任务，而能效核心则负责日常后台任务——这一切都实现了业界领先的每瓦性能。 因此，图像编辑、代码编译、新文件索引以及运行智能体式 AI 工作负载等高要求的 CPU 任务，其速度比以往任何时候都快。

paragraphs.en: Accelerated GPU and Faster Memory Bandwidth
paragraphs.zh: 加速的 GPU 与更快的内存带宽

paragraphs.en: M6 features a 12-core GPU — two more cores than M5 — with a Neural Accelerator in each core. This design delivers a nearly 30 percent increase in peak GPU compute for AI compared to M5, and more than 8x compared to M1, enabling significantly faster prompt processing when interacting with on-device LLMs. 2
paragraphs.zh: M6 配备了一颗 12 核 GPU——比 M5 多两个核心——每个核心都内置了神经加速器。 与 M5 相比，这种设计将 AI 峰值 GPU 计算性能提升了近 30%，与 M1 相比则提升了超过 8 倍，从而在与设备本地大语言模型交互时实现了显著更快的提示处理速度。 2

sents.en: M6 features a 12-core GPU — two more cores than M5 — with a Neural Accelerator in each core.
sents.zh: M6 配备了一颗 12 核 GPU——比 M5 多两个核心——每个核心都内置了神经加速器。

sents.en: This design delivers a nearly 30 percent increase in peak GPU compute for AI compared to M5, and more than 8x compared to M1, enabling significantly faster prompt processing when interacting with on-device LLMs. 2
sents.zh: 与 M5 相比，这种设计将 AI 峰值 GPU 计算性能提升了近 30%，与 M1 相比则提升了超过 8 倍，从而在与设备本地大语言模型交互时实现了显著更快的提示处理速度。 2

paragraphs.en: In addition, M6 offers Apple’s latest advanced graphics capabilities, including updates to the shader core architecture, Dynamic Caching, and hardware-accelerated ray tracing. These technologies combine to deliver stunning visual realism, faster rendering, and higher frame rates for gaming. M6 also has 50 percent increased geometry rates for complex graphics.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，M6 还带来了苹果最新的先进图形功能，包括着色器核心架构的更新、动态缓存以及硬件加速的光线追踪。 这些技术相结合，可为游戏带来惊艳的视觉真实感、更快的渲染速度和更高的帧率。 M6 的复杂图形几何处理速率也提升了 50%。

sents.en: In addition, M6 offers Apple’s latest advanced graphics capabilities, including updates to the shader core architecture, Dynamic Caching, and hardware-accelerated ray tracing.
sents.zh: 此外，M6 还带来了苹果最新的先进图形功能，包括着色器核心架构的更新、动态缓存以及硬件加速的光线追踪。

sents.zh: 这些技术相结合，可为游戏带来惊艳的视觉真实感、更快的渲染速度和更高的帧率。

sents.en: M6 also has 50 percent increased geometry rates for complex graphics.
sents.zh: M6 的复杂图形几何处理速率也提升了 50%。

paragraphs.en: M6 supports up to 32GB of unified memory to multitask across demanding apps and run LLMs on device for secure and private agentic tasks. It also provides up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth — a 10 percent increase over M5 and a 2.5x increase over M1.
paragraphs.zh: M6 支持高达 32GB 的统一内存，可跨多个高要求应用程序进行多任务处理，并直接在设备上运行大型语言模型（LLM），以执行安全且私密的智能体任务。 它还提供了高达 170GB/s 的统一内存带宽——比 M5 提升了 10%，比 M1 提升了 2.5 倍。

sents.en: M6 supports up to 32GB of unified memory to multitask across demanding apps and run LLMs on device for secure and private agentic tasks.
sents.zh: M6 支持高达 32GB 的统一内存，可跨多个高要求应用程序进行多任务处理，并直接在设备上运行大型语言模型（LLM），以执行安全且私密的智能体任务。

sents.en: It also provides up to 170GB/s of unified memory bandwidth — a 10 percent increase over M5 and a 2.5x increase over M1.

paragraphs.en: M5 Ultra: The Ultimate Powerhouse for Pro Workflows
paragraphs.zh: M5 Ultra：专业工作流程的终极性能猛兽

paragraphs.en: M5 Ultra, Apple’s most powerful chip ever, is built for pros who need to speed through workloads that demand maximum CPU and GPU performance and unified memory bandwidth, such as complex 3D rendering, visual effects, scientific analysis, and running compute-intensive frontier AI models on device.
paragraphs.zh: M5 Ultra 是苹果迄今最强大的芯片，专为需要以最高 CPU 和 GPU 性能及统一内存带宽快速处理复杂任务的专业人士而设计，例如复杂的 3D 渲染、视觉效果、科学分析，以及在设备端运行计算密集型前沿 AI 模型。

paragraphs.en: M5 Ultra uses UltraFusion to connect two dual-die M5 Max chips to form the quad-die architecture — a first for Apple silicon. UltraFusion increases the inter-die bandwidth to over 4.4TB/s and the connection density by over 6x. Together, these ultra-low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnects allow the four dies to behave as a single unified processor. M5 Ultra also features a large up-to-36-core CPU consisting of 12 super cores and 24 performance cores, delivering up to 1.25x higher single-threaded performance and up to 1.3x higher multithreaded performance than M3 Ultra. 3
paragraphs.zh: M5 Ultra 采用 UltraFusion 技术将两颗双芯片 M5 Max 连接起来，形成四芯片架构——这是 Apple 芯片的首次尝试。 UltraFusion 将芯片间带宽提升至超过 4.4TB/s，连接密度则提升了超过 6 倍。 这些超低延迟、高带宽的互连技术共同使四颗芯片能够像单个统一处理器一样运行。 M5 Ultra 还配备了一颗多达 36 核的大型 CPU，包含 12 个超级核心和 24 个性能核心，其单线程性能最高可达 M3 Ultra 的 1.25 倍，多线程性能最高可达 1.3 倍。

sents.en: M5 Ultra uses UltraFusion to connect two dual-die M5 Max chips to form the quad-die architecture — a first for Apple silicon.
sents.zh: M5 Ultra 采用 UltraFusion 技术将两颗双芯片 M5 Max 连接起来，形成四芯片架构——这是 Apple 芯片的首次尝试。

sents.zh: UltraFusion 将芯片间带宽提升至超过 4.4TB/s，连接密度则提升了超过 6 倍。

paragraphs.en: Unprecedented AI and Graphics, Massive Memory Capacity
paragraphs.zh: 前所未有的 AI 与图形技术，超大内存容量

paragraphs.en: M5 Ultra features a next-generation GPU with up to 80 cores, incorporating a Neural Accelerator in each core to offer up to 4.5x the peak GPU compute for AI compared to M3 Ultra and over 6x more than M1 Ultra. 3 The GPU includes Apple’s latest shader core with second-generation Dynamic Caching, as well as hardware-accelerated mesh shading and third-generation ray tracing, delivering up to 40 percent faster graphics performance than M3 Ultra. 3
paragraphs.zh: M5 Ultra 搭载新一代 GPU，最多拥有 80 个核心，每个核心均集成神经加速引擎，与 M3 Ultra 相比，其 AI 峰值 GPU 计算性能最高可达 4.5 倍，比 M1 Ultra 更是高出 6 倍以上。3 该 GPU 采用 Apple 最新的着色器核心，支持第二代动态缓存，并配备硬件加速的网格着色和第三代光线追踪技术，图形性能较 M3 Ultra 最高提升 40%。3

paragraphs.en: M5 Ultra incorporates a more capable Media Engine. Dedicated hardware-enabled H.264, HEVC, four ProRes encode and decode engines, and hardware-accelerated AV1 decode make it the ultimate solution for high-resolution video editing. M5 Ultra also includes a 32-core Neural Engine, driving complex AI tasks and Apple Intelligence features securely on device with industry-leading energy efficiency. 4
paragraphs.zh: M5 Ultra 搭载了性能更强大的媒体引擎。 专用的硬件支持 H.264、HEVC、四种 ProRes 编码与解码引擎，以及硬件加速的 AV1 解码，使其成为高分辨率视频编辑的最终解决方案。 M5 Ultra 还包含一个 32 核神经网络引擎，能够以行业领先的能效，在设备本地安全地处理复杂的 AI 任务和 Apple Intelligence 功能。

sents.en: M5 Ultra incorporates a more capable Media Engine.
sents.zh: M5 Ultra 搭载了性能更强大的媒体引擎。

sents.en: Dedicated hardware-enabled H.264, HEVC, four ProRes encode and decode engines, and hardware-accelerated AV1 decode make it the ultimate solution for high-resolution video editing.
sents.zh: 专用的硬件支持 H.264、HEVC、四种 ProRes 编码与解码引擎，以及硬件加速的 AV1 解码，使其成为高分辨率视频编辑的最终解决方案。

sents.en: M5 Ultra also includes a 32-core Neural Engine, driving complex AI tasks and Apple Intelligence features securely on device with industry-leading energy efficiency. 4
sents.zh: M5 Ultra 还包含一个 32 核神经网络引擎，能够以行业领先的能效，在设备本地安全地处理复杂的 AI 任务和 Apple Intelligence 功能。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, M5 Ultra features a massive amount of high-bandwidth unified memory, up to 512GB, and delivers a staggering 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth that is 50 percent higher than M3 Ultra. This lets users store huge datasets entirely in local memory, increase the tokens-per-second speed, and run huge LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，M5 Ultra 配备了超大容量的高带宽统一内存，最高可达 512GB，并提供了高达 1.2TB/s 的统一内存带宽，比 M3 Ultra 高出 50%。 这使得用户能够将海量数据集完全存储在本地内存中，提升每秒处理标记的速度，并直接在设备端运行参数规模达数千亿的大型语言模型。

sents.en: Additionally, M5 Ultra features a massive amount of high-bandwidth unified memory, up to 512GB, and delivers a staggering 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth that is 50 percent higher than M3 Ultra.
sents.zh: 此外，M5 Ultra 配备了超大容量的高带宽统一内存，最高可达 512GB，并提供了高达 1.2TB/s 的统一内存带宽，比 M3 Ultra 高出 50%。

paragraphs.en: Apple’s developer frameworks and tools — including Core AI, Core ML, Metal, and Xcode — tap directly into the advanced hardware of both chips. Developers can leverage the Dual 16-core Neural Engine in M6, and the Neural Accelerators in the GPU with the massive 512GB unified memory pool and faster 1.2TB/s of unified memory bandwidth in M5 Ultra, to provide incredible AI compute capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: Apple 的开发者框架和工具——包括 Core AI、Core ML、Metal 和 Xcode——能够直接利用这两款芯片的先进硬件。 开发者可以利用 M6 中的双 16 核神经网络引擎，以及 M5 Ultra 中 GPU 的神经网络加速器、高达 512GB 的统一内存池和更快的 1.2TB/s 统一内存带宽，从而提供强大的 AI 计算能力。

paragraphs.en: With these frameworks and new chips, developers can run and fine-tune large AI models locally on their Mac. Apple’s developer tools and frameworks automatically optimize performance across the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine, and give developers the ability to use Apple Foundation Models, App Intents to tap into Apple Intelligence features, or their own proprietary AI models to build and run powerful AI workloads entirely on device.
